metadata.title: Corrected Phoneme-Interval Distance Analysis
metadata.description: Dependency distances computed in phoneme-space, testing whether phonological density predicts DLM strength

sensitivity_analysis.note: All languages use consistent phoneme estimation based on language family ratios

hypothesis_test.prediction: Phonological density is independent of DLM strength
hypothesis_test.conclusion: Phonological density shows negative correlation with DLM strength (r=-0.324, p=0.0507)
